players.product: 800G/1.6T optical transceivers + high-power ELSFP lasers (US-anchored manufacturing)

quarterly_data.signal: AAOI's 10-Q: capital expenditures were $335.1 million in the six months ended June 30, 2026 ($169.0 million in the US, $62.8 million in Taiwan and $103.3 million in China), primarily for facility expansion and equipment purchases to increase production capacity for its internet data center and broadband product lines, including Quantum Bandwidth products and 400G, 800G and 1.6T transceivers. Management expects 2026 capex to remain elevated, expects to keep investing in capacity expansion through at least the end of 2027, and expects to expand U.S. and Taiwan manufacturing during 2026 and 2027 primarily for laser diode production and 800G and 1.6T transceivers. Other assets, net (mainly long-term prepayments for capital expansion projects) were $324.0 million as of June 30, 2026 versus $50.9 million as of December 31, 2025.
